messages:
Asha: Morning all — daily triage check-in. Quick snapshot: open queue 18 (3 P1s), avg TTR ~6.2h. Notable: a recurring error on embeddings ingestion causing 5xx for some customer payloads. TL;DR: still accepting, workaround below.
Jordan: I grabbed the first P1 (cust-322). Root cause looks like payload size + timeout on the ingestion lambda. Repro steps in the ticket. Will escalate if retries don't help.
Maya: I ran a quick macro audit overnight — the `embeddings_failure` macro still points to an outdated support doc. I'll push an edit but want a QA pass.
Devon: PR ping — I opened fix branch `fix/embedding-backoff` -> PR #3624. Adds exponential backoff + payload-size check. Needs one more review before merge.
Asha: Thanks. Jordan, assign the P1 to yourself in the tracker and add the short-term workaround: `reduce batch to <= 800KB` + `3x backoff`.
Jordan: Assigned. Added workaround to ticket and posted this snippet for engineers:

```
# quick workaround
if payload_size > 800000:
  split_payload()
retry(policy=exponential, attempts=3, base_ms=200)
```

Maya: I'll update the macro text to reference the new troubleshooting steps and link PR #3624 and ticket ID 12271.
Devon: FYI deploy-bot shows the canary for the fix passed on staging earlier: deploy-bot: canary succeeded (embed-worker v2.1.3)
ticketbot: Note: scheduled auto-retry job ran 2:14am UTC and cleared ~6 stuck items.
Asha: Action items: Jordan owns P1 response + customer comms; Devon owns PR merge + staging -> prod promotion once Maya confirms macro wording; Maya to create QA checklist for macro changes.
Maya: Doing the checklist now; will ping @QA for one-pass. Also rewording the macro to be clearer about when to escalate to eng.
Jordan: Quick ask — can someone do a fast review of #3624 today? Should be small.
Devon: I can do it after standup, aim to review in the next hour.
Asha: Great. Also note: volume spike expected mid-day from onboarding batch — expect +10 tickets. If it hits, we'll flip the overflow policy to dedicated queue. I'll post here if we flip.
Maya: One tiny macro nit: change the phrase "try restarting" -> "initiate retry via console" to reduce back-and-forth with customers.
Asha: Noted. Last ask: whoever merges, please drop a short release note blurb and tag #product for visibility.
Jordan: Copy that. I'll update ticket timeline and customer ETA once we confirm prod deploy.
Asha: Thanks team — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
